acceptedAnswer.text: Payment is not currently collected through this storefront. You can explore pieces, choose variants and save a bag on this device. Delivery quotes and secure payment unlock after Stripe runtime keys are set on the host. No test or live charges are created from missing keys.

The current collection is set up for made-to-order production through Printful. An available variant means the catalog currently lists that combination as available; it does not mean a finished garment is sitting in a Hustler Dior warehouse.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a size and color?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open a piece, choose a color, then select an available size. The displayed price follows that combination. Read the fit guide before deciding on a silhouette.

The Extended Edit opens with the newest Shopify creation dates first. The main collection follows Printful’s current store listing; that API does not provide creation dates, so its ordering does not establish a garment’s original release date.
Your bag is saved in this browser on this device. Clearing browser storage removes it. It does not automatically transfer to another device, and adding a piece does not reserve inventory.

mainEntity.name: When will shipping and returns be available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery quotes and the store’s shipping and returns policies appear with checkout once Stripe is configured. We are not promising a delivery date or a free-shipping threshold while payment is unavailable.

mainEntity.name: Can I find women’s and men’s streetwear here?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Browse the women’s edit or the men’s edit. Both include unisex pieces alongside the catalog’s gender-specific styles.
